passages.text: Plants of the World Online account: Ophrys × turiana J.E.Arnold.
The native range of this hybrid is S. Europe. It is a tuberous geophyte and grows primarily in the temperate biome. The hybrid formula is O. apifera × O. tenthredinifera.
